Buy once, play anywhere

Coins work across Degen Duel, Dojo Flip, Teto Wars, Cluck-Fu and Cock Brawl. No per-game top-ups, no juggling tokens mid-game.

Pay in what you hold

Play to earn raffle chances

You never win money directly — a win = 3 raffle chances, a play = 1, and winning all 5 games at least once = +3 bonus. Every Sunday the weekly Dojo Pot is drawn among chance-holders, provably-fair. Degen Dojo keeps just 12%; the rest goes back to players.
